part_A.question: Some students say they are …. They have no time for relaxation.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "busy"

part_A.question: He is of the same age _ _ me.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "as" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: He is of the same age [as] _ me.

part_A.question: Does she have … round face or … oval face?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "a / an"

part_A.question: Minh is one of the b_ _ _ students in our class.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "est" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "best". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: We always turn _ _ _ the light before leaving.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "off" → "turn off" = tắt (thiết bị).

part_A.question: It’s nearly 5 pm. “Nearly” here is similar to ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "almost" → "almost": gần như (nearly ≈ almost). | "nearly" ≈ "almost" = gần như, xấp xỉ. "beside" = bên cạnh, "before" = trước, "between" = giữa.

part_A.question: I bought some souvenirs _ _ _ my friends when I was in Nha Trang.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "for" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: I bought some souvenirs [for] _ _ my friends when I was in Nha Trang.

part_A.question: His hair should be _ _ _ . It is too long.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "cut" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: His hair should be [cut] _ _ . It is too long.

part_A.question: _ _ _ heavy are you? – I’m 45 kilos.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "How" → Từ để hỏi "How" → câu trả lời "I’m 45 kilos." cho thấy đây là hỏi về cách thức.

part_A.question: I am ... of hearing ghost stories.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "scared"

part_A.question: The meat of a pig is called ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "pork"

part_A.question: When will you come _ _ see your grandparents? – Next Sunday afternoon.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "to" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: When will you come [to] _ see your grandparents? – Next Sunday afternoon.

part_A.question: The new toys are ... display in the toy store over there.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "on"

part_A.question: How much does it … to mail a local letter in Vietnam?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "cost" → "cost": tốn kém, có giá (How much does it cost? = Giá bao nhiêu?). | "cost" = có giá, tốn kém (How much does it cost? = Giá bao nhiêu?). "pay" = trả tiền (cần tân ngữ chỉ người). "require" = yêu cầu. "take" = mất thời gian.

part_A.question: The bus leaves at exactly 4, so ... late.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "don’t be"

part_A.question: ... book is this, yours or hers?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Whose"

part_A.question: Don’t worry ... him. He will pass the exam.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "about"

part_A.question: This orange tastes ….
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "sweet"

part_A.question: Could you show me the way … the railway station please?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "to"

part_A.question: Brush_ _ _ your teeth everyday is very important.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "ing" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "brushing". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: There isn’t any ... to eat.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "meat"

part_A.question: When you see a dripping faucet, turn it _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "off" → "turn off" = tắt (thiết bị).

part_A.question: Are you free _ _ Sunday mornings?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "on" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Are you free [on] _ Sunday mornings?

part_A.question: These are their books and those are ….
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "ours"

part_A.question: Great! What does your friend look …?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "like"

part_A.question: Some students sit in the canteen and wait _ _ _ their parents.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "for" → "wait FOR somebody" (chờ ai).

part_A.question: In the ocean, … more salt in the deeper water.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "there is"

part_A.question: She sends flowers _ _ her friend.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "to" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: She sends flowers [to] _ her friend.

part_A.question: He’s a very ... reader.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "slow"

part_A.question: Excuse _ _ , where can I buy bread?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "me" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Excuse [me] _ , where can I buy bread?

part_A.question: You looked pale and tired. You should s_ _ _ inside at recess.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "tay" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "stay". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: Mr. Long has ... days off than Mr. Tuan.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "fewer"

part_A.question: _ _ _ did Hoa go to school late this morning? – Because she watched TV late last night.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "why" → Từ để hỏi "why" → câu trả lời "Because she watched TV late last night." cho thấy đây là hỏi về lý do.

part_A.question: It’s very _ _ _ in summer.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "hot" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: It’s very [hot] _ _ in summer.

part_A.question: I walk to school every _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "day" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: I walk to school every [day] _ _ .

part_A.question: Give me a cup _ _ tea, son!
part_A.explanation: Điền: "of" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Give me a cup [of] _ tea, son!

part_A.question: _ _ _ me tell you more about my family.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "Let" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: [Let] _ _ me tell you more about my family.

part_A.question: I can ... French.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "speak" → "speak": nói (speak a language / speak to somebody).

part_A.question: Let’s” is the short form of “...”.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Let us"

part_A.question: Remember _ _ wash and iron your own clothes.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "to" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Remember [to] _ wash and iron your own clothes.

part_A.question: My father often drinks a _ _ _ of tea in the morning.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "cup" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: My father often drinks a [cup] _ _ of tea in the morning.

part_A.question: I’m going to stay there _ _ _ two days.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "for" → "go for a walk" = đi dạo bộ.

part_A.question: Every year millions of people ... the common cold.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "catch" → "catch": bắt; bị (catch a cold = bị cảm lạnh).

part_A.question: I usually have ... in the morning.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "a bath"

part_A.question: She is neither a singer _ _ _ an actress.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "nor" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: She is neither a singer [nor] _ _ an actress.

part_A.question: You have made … mistakes in your writing.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "a lot of"

part_A.question: Jim is a very good friend of ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "mine" → "a friend of mine" = một người bạn của tôi (cấu trúc sở hữu kép).

part_A.question: Nga: … do you go to school? - Quan: I go to school by bicycle.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "How"

part_A.question: Mary is _ _ _ only child of her parents.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "the" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Mary is [the] _ _ only child of her parents.

part_A.question: This dictionary is very useful _ _ _ you to learn English.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "for" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: This dictionary is very useful [for] _ _ you to learn English.

part_A.question: Such a hard working day. I … to go straight to bed right now.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "want"

part_A.question: Let me ... a look at your homework.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "have"

part_A.question: Mike likes oranges and _ _ does Marry.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "so" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Mike likes oranges and [so] _ does Marry.

part_A.question: There are … apples in the refrigerator.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "some" → "some" dùng trong câu khẳng định với danh từ không đếm được hoặc số nhiều.

part_A.question: Her office is _ _ the sixth floor of the building.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "on" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Her office is [on] _ the sixth floor of the building.

part_A.question: The nurse will ... your height again.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "measure" → "measure": đo lường (measure height/weight = đo chiều cao/cân nặng).
